criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Educational Institution
categories.definition: An organization providing educational services, such as schools and universities.

categories.name: Politician
categories.definition: An individual involved in politics, often holding or having held a political office.

categories.name: Film
categories.definition: A motion picture or movie, including documentaries and feature films.

categories.name: Building or Structure
categories.definition: A constructed edifice or facility, such as towers, churches, and historical buildings.

categories.name: Company or Organization
categories.definition: A business or non-profit entity, including corporations, firms, and associations.

categories.name: Village or Town
categories.definition: A small settlement or community, often in rural areas.

categories.name: Album
categories.definition: A collection of audio recordings issued as a single item, typically on CD, vinyl, or digital formats.

categories.name: Professional Athlete
categories.definition: An individual who competes in sports at a professional level.

categories.name: Species
categories.definition: A group of living organisms consisting of similar individuals capable of exchanging genes or interbreeding.

categories.name: Book or Novel
categories.definition: A written or printed work consisting of pages bound together, typically a narrative or scholarly work.

categories.name: Musician or Band
categories.definition: An individual or group that performs music, either as singers or instrumentalists.

categories.name: Historical Event or Object
categories.definition: An occurrence or item of historical significance, such as battleships or historical artifacts.

categories.name: Journal or Magazine
categories.definition: A periodical publication containing articles and illustrations, often on a particular subject or aimed at a particular readership.

categories.name: Geographical Feature
categories.definition: A natural or man-made feature of the Earth's surface, such as mountains, rivers, or lakes.

categories.name: Cultural or Religious Site
categories.definition: A location of cultural or religious significance, such as temples, churches, or heritage sites.

categories.name: Transportation
categories.definition: A means or system of transporting people or goods, such as vehicles, ships, or aircraft.

categories.name: Art or Artist
categories.definition: A work of art or an individual who creates art, including painters, sculptors, and other visual artists.

categories.name: Government or Military Entity
categories.definition: An organization or unit within the government or military, such as departments, agencies, or military units.

categories.name: Technology or Software
categories.definition: A product or system related to technology or software, including hardware, applications, and IT companies.

categories.name: Historical Figure
categories.definition: An individual from history known for their contributions or significance in a particular field or event.

categories.name: Sporting Event or Team
categories.definition: An organized competition or group of athletes participating in a sport.

categories.name: Mythology or Fictional Character
categories.definition: A character from mythology or fiction, often part of a larger narrative or cultural tradition.

categories.name: Legal or Political Document
categories.definition: A formal document related to law or politics, such as treaties, constitutions, or legislative acts.

categories.name: Food or Beverage
categories.definition: An item consumed for nutritional or culinary purposes, including dishes, drinks, and ingredients.

categories.name: Festival or Event
categories.definition: A public celebration or gathering, often recurring, centered around a theme or activity.
